name: form
title: Form
description: react-hook-form fields laid out as the dashboard's: a body-sm label above the control, help and errors in caption.
usage: Build a validated form: wrap it in Form with useForm's methods, then FormField with a render function that returns FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl around one control, FormDescription and FormMessage. FormControl wires the id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid; FormMessage shows the field's error.
avoid: A red label on an invalid field
Validating on every keystroke before the first submit

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
